summary: Retest after fix for the profile-menu MenuGroupContext crash (AdminLayout.tsx DropdownMenuGroup wrap). Re-seeded DB to restore pending verification applications consumed by earlier runs (per seed_facts note), then re-ran full backend suite (9/9 passed) and all 8 previously-authored browser checks (8/8 passed), including logout-blocks-dashboard-again which exercises the exact iteration-1 crash path (open admin-profile-trigger -> profile-menu-signout) and now completes with no pageerror and correct session invalidation.

action_items.detail: Verification backend tests (test_tscheck_partner_verification_decision_flow.py) initially failed with 0 pending applications because earlier test/browser runs had approved all seeded pending rows (as flagged in seed_facts). Re-ran `python seed.py` to restore fixture data; suite passed cleanly afterward. Not an application bug, just fixture exhaustion across iterations - future runs may need re-seeding again.
